repairs.text: De res, Biel. Espera, que t’aguanto la funda mentre hi poses el full... així... Fins dijous, i ja m’explicaràs com va l’assaig.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce funda /ˈfun.də/ with stressed U and audible N followed by D: FUN-da, never funa or fona. Keep the adult male Elies voice; do not read this instruction. Prior renderings omitted D or changed U to O. Give the N-D transition enough articulation to hear both consonants, without adding a vowel or spelling letters aloud.

repairs.text: Aquí tens el carro, amb una nansa a cada extrem. La bossa ja és dins d’aquesta funda. Obro la porta: prova’l.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce funda /ˈfun.də/ with stressed U and audible N followed by D: FUN-da, never funa or fona. Keep the adult male Elies/Algieba voice throughout the whole turn. Do not read this instruction.
repairs.rejection: fona o funa en lloc de funda

repairs.text: Bon dia. Vinc a tornar la novel·la que em vaig endur. Em falta llegir l’últim capítol, però em sembla que l’havia de tornar avui. Em podríeu deixar uns dies més?
repairs.pronunciation: Read the complete first Ferran turn, including Em falta llegir l’últim capítol, però em sembla que l’havia de tornar avui. Keep warm older male Ferran/Algenib throughout. Do not skip any sentence or read this direction.

repairs.text: Pel passeig en trigaríem uns vint. Ara són les quatre i tenim fins a les cinc per tornar a casa. La mare ens vindrà a buscar llavors.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce the Catalan word passeig clearly, preserving the written E vowel; never say passaig. Keep the natural Catalan stress and final consonant, and the warm older male Ferran/Algenib identity. Read the entire supplied turn once; do not read this instruction.

repairs.text: Tracte fet. I el pròxim cop posa’m les botes al costat de la porta, que avui he sortit ben mudat per anar a trepitjar bassals.
repairs.pronunciation: Pronounce bassals clearly: ba-SALS, stressed on the final syllable, with unvoiced SS and a plain final L plus S. Never change the ending into palatal LL or say basalls. Keep the warm older male Ferran/Algenib identity. Read the entire supplied turn once; do not read this instruction.
